Dear Colleagues, the DC1 is out of order due to Modbus timeout, please check if the Ethernet cable is fitted properly. Try using the Ethernet cable from KF11, it might give us a hint if the Ethernet cable is broken or not.
If it doesn't work, please trial a new KF12 and see if it's fixed.
